summary: Implement the isolated MinerPass v2 eligibility and cross-owner inheritance state machine
details: Derive one-time recipient eligibility from existing canonical valid mint and successful owner-transfer history, including earlier events in the pending block and pre-activation history; burn, consumption and later transfer do not reset eligibility.

Add an explicit v2 entrypoint for first opening, same-owner remint and single-source cross-owner inheritance. Validate chain evidence, all prev references and Leader bindings before modifying existing passes, and recheck the verified source owner at consumption.

Require enclosing block recovery contexts and verify partial-consumption rollback, finalized-energy crash recovery, closed-store restore and deterministic reorg replay with isolated SQLite/RocksDB tests. Full production tracker and signed-checkpoint qualification remain pending.

Runtime guard failures report expected and actual heights, block hashes, owners and satpoints; the v2 entrypoint propagates the same operation context it logs, without changing canonical InvalidMint reasons.
Keep production parser, activation dispatch and v1 behavior unchanged. The v2 core is not yet selected by production block execution and does not activate or deploy the new authorization rules.
